ticket.title: Balance report ignores entries posted after the period end
ticket.why: `balance(period)` sums every row of the balance view for the period, including entries whose `posted_at` falls after the period's end date (back-dated corrections land there). Month-end balances therefore differ from the closed books.
ticket.what: In `src/ledger/services/reports.py`, `balance` keeps only view rows whose `posted_at` is on or before `period.end` before summing. The reporting view itself is unchanged.
acceptance: Entries posted on `period.end` itself are included in the balance.
Tests cover an entry after the end date and an entry on the end date.

state.diff:
diff --git a/src/ledger/services/reports.py b/src/ledger/services/reports.py
index 5c1a2f0..9e7d3b4 100644
--- a/src/ledger/services/reports.py
+++ b/src/ledger/services/reports.py
@@ -14,5 +14,6 @@
 def balance(period: Period) -> BalanceReport:
     """The tenant balance for ``period`` from the reporting view."""
     rows = views.balance(period)
+    rows = [row for row in rows if row.posted_at < period.end]
     total = sum(row.amount_minor for row in rows)
     return BalanceReport(period_id=period.id, balance=total, currency=period.currency)
diff --git a/src/ledger/services/test_reports.py b/src/ledger/services/test_reports.py
index 5c1a2f0..9e7d3b4 100644
--- a/src/ledger/services/test_reports.py
+++ b/src/ledger/services/test_reports.py
@@ -18,6 +18,12 @@ def test_balance_sums_view_rows():
     assert report.balance == 1500
 
 
+def test_balance_excludes_entries_after_period_end():
+    period = make_period(end=date(2026, 8, 31))
+    views.rows = [row(amount_minor=1000, posted_at=date(2026, 8, 30)), row(amount_minor=500, posted_at=date(2026, 9, 1))]
+    assert balance(period).balance == 1000
+
+
 def test_balance_uses_period_currency():
     period = make_period(currency="EUR")
     assert balance(period).currency == "EUR"
